credit_note: 13 new dig candidates (65 credits) were generated on 2026-09-22 before the project's API key reached its 2000-credit quota (HTTP 401 quota_exceeded, 1 credit left; the failed requests were not billed). The remaining materials and every attack cue are layered from unused or rejected takes that earlier sessions generated with the same account (receipts and hashes re-verified) plus seeded numpy synthesis layers.
review_basis: Waveform/spectrogram inspection and metric gates (onset, 40 ms body RMS, peak, spectral centroid, energy decay, tail). No subjective listening approval is asserted.
source_note: Original generated Foley plus seeded numpy synthesis layers. No game or third-party recordings used. Generating account terms apply.
rejected: dig-grass-1 alone: a low earth thud with no rustle; kept only as the thud layer under the grass rustle takes.
dig-wood-1 and dig-wood-2 alone: -38 dBFS and -27 dBFS broadband decays with no knock; dig-wood-2 kept under a synthesized hollow wood resonance.

footsteps step-cloth-1/3/6, step-stone-3/4/9, step-sand-3/4/6 and the step-metal cuts shipped as footfalls are not reused as-is; metal digs use other contacts of step-metal-4/5, and the armour cues re-pitch (x0.78-0.85) and low-pass step-metal-3/6.
remaining impact-metal-2: -54 dBFS with a stationary noise floor; unusable.
pickaxe-impact knife-1/2/3: -46 dBFS sub-bass decays with no contact, as the 2026-09-08 review found.
hits hithead-3 and hit-audio ticks: too small and clean for a melee attack body.
pickaxe-rock pickaxeimpact-2 and swoosh knife-2 / swing knife-1 already ship as the pickaxe impact and swing; not reused.
